data.content_ref: inline:Introduce a dynamic re-computation protocol that, after an edge insertion or deletion, updates the grounded statuses incrementally by reusing the previous least fixpoint, with a change-propagation order that provably reaches the same fixpoint in polynomial total time. This makes the semantics responsive to new evidence without recomputing from scratch, and preserves determinism because the incremental result is defined as the unique least fixpoint of the updated graph.
